title: Lightly Blanched Dutch Avocado Flatbread
description: A savory and flaky Dutch dish featuring avocado Hass pulp, this flatbread is perfect for adventurous eaters, and its macrobiotic-friendly ingredients make it a great option for those with dietary restrictions. The lightly blanched avocado adds a unique twist to this traditional flatbread recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, thyme, rosemary, and garlic powder.
Add the olive oil and water to the bowl and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the blanched avocado pulp evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the avocado to form a crust.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
